class.name: FmodAudioEffectEQ10
class.description: FmodAudioEffectEQ10 is a 10-band graphic equalizer using FMOD's MULTIBAND_EQ DSP. Its initial center frequencies span 31.25 Hz through 16000 Hz. Each band can be individually adjusted for gain (-60 dB to +24 dB), frequency, Q value, and filter type. By default, all bands use peaking filters with a Q value of 0.707. The initial center frequencies are 31.25 Hz, 62.5 Hz, 125 Hz, 250 Hz, 500 Hz, 1000 Hz, 2000 Hz, 4000 Hz, 8000 Hz, and 16000 Hz. [b]Note:[/b] For simpler control, use [FmodAudioEffectEQ6]. For professional-grade equalization, use [FmodAudioEffectEQ21].

members.member: The initial preset is [constant FmodAudioEffectEQ.PRESET_10_BANDS]. The inherited [method FmodAudioEffectEQ.set_preset] can change it and reinitialize the bands.
